identity_definition: Concatenate six frozen IMGT CDR regions; count identical amino acids over pairwise columns occupied in at least one sequence; gap-gap excluded, residue-gap a difference. Counts of substitutions refer to each candidate own parent.
alignment_definition: Within a predictor and seed42, align to the chosen dog-target parent. Core uses only 330 receptor C-alpha atoms and considers AB/BA equivalent placements; framework uses shared frozen IMGT framework positions jointly from H/L. These transforms serve display and never change saved rankings.
